params.text:
Based on my analysis of the Android-IMSI-Catcher-Detector repository:

1. The repository does NOT have a 'main' branch - it uses 'master' as the default/protected branch.
2. According to the contributors page, the top contributor to the master branch is 'SecUpwN' with 824 commits.
3. The email address associated with 'SecUpwN' is 'SecUpwN@users.noreply.github.com'.
4. There is also another entry for what appears to be the same person under the name 'Security: PWNED' with email 'SecUpwN@protonmail.ch' (28 commits).

Therefore, the email address of the contributor with the most commits to the primary branch (master, which is equivalent to main in this repository) is: SecUpwN@users.noreply.github.com
